title: fieldwork::communities — AP Group actors for communities
description: Community model: Group actor type with name, description, rules, moderators. Communities own posts (attributedTo the Group). Members follow the Group to see posts. Moderators can pin/remove/lock posts. Maps to Lemmy's community model. Uses persona_db (a community IS a persona with type=Group).
close_reason: Community mode complete. communities_db (28 functions, 33 tests, hot sort), AP Group actors, Lemmy API v3 (12 endpoints) in all 3 servers.
